mapper.insert: INSERT INTO import_record (user_id, project_id, batch_id, file_name, file_size, object_name, bucket_name, upload_id, chunk_size, total_chunks, uploaded_chunks, uploaded_bytes, status, create_time, update_time) VALUES (#{userId}, #{projectId}, #{batchId}, #{fileName}, #{fileSize}, #{objectName}, #{bucketName}, #{uploadId}, #{chunkSize}, #{totalChunks}, 0, 0, #{status}, NOW(), NOW())
mapper.select: SELECT * FROM import_record WHERE id = #{id} AND user_id = #{userId}
mapper.update: UPDATE import_record SET status = #{status}, update_time = NOW() WHERE id = #{id}
